caption:
Slow replies happen. A pattern is different, especially when other people are blocked waiting.

Save this for the next time you need to say it plainly.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #peoplemanagement

slides.headline: Manager rules for the person who keeps replying <u>late</u>.
In that talk, do these four things.
items: Name it: “Replies have been slow lately.”
Say the impact: “It slows other work down.”
Ask what’s getting in the way
Set the norm: “Reply by end of day.”

slides.headline: Don’t argue about whether they’re “busy.” Talk about what the team <u>needs</u>.
slides.sub: Kind, direct, and easy to act on.
